title: FrontRow: copy the current Supabase service key
_note: Step 1 of 3 for the FrontRow token 503 (2026-11-07). The key value is never read, printed or stored by Yeshie: Mike copies it to his clipboard and pastes it in the Netlify guide (app.netlify.com/guides/set-supabase-service-key.guide.json). default_rotated_20260811 is the current key: its own description says it replaced default_rotated_20260723b, which was exposed in a transcript on 2026-08-04. The tab stays open so Mike can copy again if the paste fails.

steps.instruction: Click the copy button on the default_rotated_20260811 row under Secret keys. That puts the current FrontRow service key on your clipboard. Do not reveal it.
steps.target: tr:has(button[aria-label="More actions for API key default_rotated_20260811"]) button[aria-label="Copy API key"]
